newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $23 bln 45-day cash bills Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $23 bln 45-day cash bills Feb 27.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said on Tuesday that it will auction $23 billion of 45-day cash management bills on Feb 27.
The bills will be issued March 3 and will mature on April 17.
Minimum bids will be in amounts of $10,000.
Noncompetitive tenders will be accepted in full up to $1 million at the average discount rate of accepted competitive bids, which must be received by 1130 EST (1630 GMT).
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944F8.
